description: A command that hit its deadline may be retried with a larger timeout_ms; the identical retry with the same budget is refused with a message that says how to retry. Idle/cancel lockouts are unit-tested; this is the model-facing contract.
prompt: Run the slow check; if it times out, retry it with more time.

script.text: The retry with a larger budget ran and timed out again.

stdout_contains: The retry with a larger budget ran and timed out again.
